name: firebase
description: Add Firebase for authentication, Firestore database, and Cloud Storage. Includes both client SDK and server-side Admin SDK.

setup: 1. Create a Firebase project at https://console.firebase.google.com
2. Enable Authentication, Firestore, and Storage in Firebase Console
3. Copy your web app config to .env.local (NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars)
4. Generate a service account key for Admin SDK (FIREBASE_* private vars)
6. Configure protected routes in middleware.ts as needed
usage: Client SDK: import { auth, db, storage } from '@/lib/firebase/client'
Admin SDK: import { getAdminAuth, getAdminDb } from '@/lib/firebase/admin'
Auth Context: Wrap app with <AuthProvider> from '@/lib/firebase/auth-context'
